steps.title: Analyze Session Timeout Request
steps.description: Understand user requirement: Wake up once via wake-word, then allow direct commands for 10 minutes without repeating 'Hey Popeen'.

steps.title: Add Active Session Variables
steps.description: Introduce variables in VoiceAssistantService to track session start time and duration (10 minutes).

steps.title: Modify Wake Word Detection State
steps.description: When 'Hey Popeen' is matched, initialize the 10-minute active window expiry timestamp.

steps.title: Update Command Response Transition
steps.description: Upon completing a command response, check if the session is still within the 10-minute window. If active, return directly to command listening instead of wake word listening.

steps.title: Update Speech Timeout and Error Handlers
steps.description: Ensure speech timeouts or failures during the active session restart the command listener directly instead of reverting to wake word detection.

steps.title: Enrich Activity Log with Session Context
steps.description: Add logs informing the user of the active session state and the remaining time until they need to say 'Hey Popeen' again.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure no Java 9+ syntax or lambdas are introduced during session lifecycle integration.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Perform dynamic build with the new 10-minute persistent listening feature enabled.
